checks.describe: deep-dive S1: the MCP server answers a tools/list request over JSON-RPC — the discovery step of the session lifecycle
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get pod -l app=mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'

checks.describe: deep-dive S1: an unknown JSON-RPC method returns a protocol error with code -32601 (Method not found)
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get pod -l app=mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab exec $POD -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":9,"method":"pods/list"}'

checks.describe: deep-dive S2: the projected SA volume mounts token, ca.crt, and namespace at the serviceaccount path
checks.run: POD=$(kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab get pod -l app=mcp-server -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core -n m10-lab exec $POD -- ls /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/

checks.describe: deep-dive S2: the TokenRequest API mints an audience-scoped, short-duration bound token (a JWT) for the agent SA
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core create token ai-agent -n m10-lab --audience https://kubernetes.default.svc --duration 10m 2>/dev/null

checks.describe: deep-dive S3: RBAC escalation prevention — the read-only agent SA cannot create RoleBindings
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core auth can-i create rolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io -n m10-lab --as=system:serviceaccount:m10-lab:ai-agent

checks.describe: deep-dive S3: secrets are excluded from the agent role — the agent SA is denied get on secrets
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core auth can-i get secrets -n m10-lab --as=system:serviceaccount:m10-lab:ai-agent

checks.describe: deep-dive S3: the scoped read-only ClusterRole still permits the agent SA to list pods (least-privilege, not no-privilege)
checks.run: kubectl --context kind-kubeadv-core auth can-i list pods -n m10-lab --as=system:serviceaccount:m10-lab:ai-agent
